title: UneceIOTDevice
description:
An IOT (Internet of Things) piece of mechanical or electronic equipment which can collect, report and autonomously
transmit digital data.

attachedAssetId.description: The identifier for the asset, such as a container, to which this monitoring IOT device is attached.

communicationCapabilityCode.description: The code specifying the communication capability of this monitoring IOT device.

embeddedSensor.description: An embedded sensor of this monitoring IOT device.

grantedCertificate.description: A product certificate granted for this monitoring IOT device.

identifier.description: An identifier for this monitoring IOT device.

interfaceEquipment.description: An interface between an OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) equipment and this monitoring IOT device.

latestReceivedGeographicalCoordinate.description: The latest geographical coordinates received by this monitoring IOT device, from the perspective of the receiver.

latestReceivedSignalDateTime.description:
The date, time, date time or other date time value of the latest received signal for this monitoring IOT device, from
the perspective of the receiver.

manufacturerParty.description: The manufacturer party of this monitoring IOT device.

modelId.description: A model identifier for this monitoring IOT device.

operationalStatusCode.description: The code specifying the operational status, such as broken, stolen, unpaired, inactive of this monitoring IOT device.

operatorParty.description: The operator party, such as terminal operator, service provider, network operator of this monitoring IOT device.

ownerParty.description: The owner party of this monitoring IOT device.

positionCode.description: The code specifying the position of this monitoring IOT device.

powerSourceTypeCode.description: The code specifying a type of power source for this monitoring IOT device.

providerParty.description: The provider party for this monitoring IOT device.

relatedEvent.description: A communication event related to this monitoring IOT device.

remainingBatteryChargePercent.description: The percentage of the remaining battery charge of this monitoring IOT device.

remoteSensor.description: A remote sensor of this monitoring IOT device.

reportedTransportEvent.description: A transport event reported by this monitoring IOT device.

reportingSensorPairing.description: A sensor communication pairing reported for this monitoring IOT device.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of monitoring IOT device.
